# ✨ Feature Request

Thank you for taking the time to suggest a new feature.

Please provide the following information to help us understand your proposal.

---

# Summary

Provide a brief and clear description of the proposed feature.

---

# Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation that this feature would solve.

Examples:

- Missing reconnaissance capability
- Performance limitation
- Reporting enhancement
- Dashboard improvement
- Plugin architecture enhancement
- Usability improvement

---

# Proposed Solution

Describe your proposed solution in as much detail as possible.

---

# Feature Category

Select the category that best matches your proposal.

- [ ] Core Framework
- [ ] Plugin System
- [ ] Passive Enumeration
- [ ] DNS Resolution
- [ ] HTTP Probe
- [ ] Port Scanner
- [ ] Technology Detection
- [ ] Screenshot Capture
- [ ] URL Discovery
- [ ] JavaScript Analysis
- [ ] Directory Fuzzing
- [ ] Virtual Host Discovery
- [ ] TLS Analysis
- [ ] WAF Detection
- [ ] CDN Detection
- [ ] Takeover Detection
- [ ] Email Security
- [ ] Reporting
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Other

---

# Expected Benefits

Describe how this feature would improve the framework.

Examples:

- Better reconnaissance coverage
- Faster execution
- Improved reporting
- Better user experience
- Easier extensibility
- Reduced false positives

---

# Example Usage

If applicable, provide an example.

```bash
python recon.py example.com --new-feature
```

---

# Alternative Solutions

Describe any alternative solutions or approaches you have considered.

---

# Additional Information

Include any relevant references, screenshots, research, or external resources that may help explain the feature request.

---

# Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting.

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests.
- [ ] This feature has not already been requested.
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem.
- [ ] I have provided a proposed solution.
- [ ] This feature aligns with the goals of Recon Automation Framework.
